zh:
慕尼黑工业大学（Technical University of Munich，简称TUM）成立于1868年，位于德国巴伐利亚州慕尼黑市，是德国顶尖的公立研究型大学，也是德国精英大学联盟核心成员。学校下设15个学院，覆盖工程、自然科学、医学、建筑、社会科学等领域，在校生超58000人。
慕尼黑工业大学被誉为“德国的麻省理工”，是德国工程技术领域的最高学府，培养了17位诺贝尔奖得主、3位菲尔兹奖得主，在工程、计算机科学、自然科学、人工智能等领域长期处于欧洲领先地位。学校注重产学研结合，与宝马、西门子等全球知名企业深度合作。2026QS世界大学排名中，慕尼黑工业大学位列世界第22位。
en: Technical University of Munich (TUM) is a top public research university in Germany. Founded in 1868, it is located in Munich, Bavaria, and a core member of the German Universities of Excellence. The University comprises 15 faculties, covering engineering, natural sciences, medicine, architecture, and social sciences, with over 58,000 enrolled students. Known as 'Germany's MIT', TUM is the country's leading institution for engineering and technology, having produced 17 Nobel Prize winners and 3 Fields Medalists. Ranked No.22 in the world in the 2026 QS World University Rankings.
